intro: Sheridan is a small ranch and railroad town at the foot of the Bighorn Mountains, with I-90 running the night traffic along the edge of the valley. After the shops close, the dark here is wide rather than loud. Pump Six fits that hour. An overnight clerk watches a black sedan pull up to a pump and never buy gas. The clerk does not live in Sheridan. The Ryan Kane Series is not set in Wyoming. This page will not dress the fiction up as a local crime report or a guidebook. It is a door for a Sheridan reader who wants a short psychological thriller before sleep, written in the same world as the novels and kept separate from them. When the story ends, HUNTED, the prequel, is free on BookFunnel. Fractured Ground is the next novel, and its only link here is the Kindle edition. Book three, Digital Ascent, has a free advance copy for readers who want to go further. Pump Six also has its own free-read address, so this Sheridan page can stay about the town you already know: rails, ranch country, and the mountains on the horizon. Read the clerk's shift. Take the prequel if you want the longer night.
